balls.text: Into the blockhole once more, but lofted down to long-off once more. Fielder slides in there to cut off any hopes of a bounfary. LSG finish on 228 because of that massive start... but they scored just one four in the last three overs!
Great yorker, right on the wide marker. Driven down to covers without much conviction
Himmat loves his sweeps more than anything, eh! And why not, if you can keep sweeping Chahar. Full and outside off, near the wide marker. He plays this fine towards backward square leg
French cuts this down to fine leg! Another one speared into the blockhole, right outside off. Markram loses his shape while looking to drive this down the ground, he'll take the single over nothing
Speared in full outside off, swings across the line and somehow gets this to dribble out to backward square leg
Full and outside off, drilled right into his pads. The edge then thuds from pad down to covers
this time, long-on runs in to cut another lofted drive off. Speared in and another low full toss, but 139.9 clicks. Batter struggles to get under this

Himmat takes care of this juicy full toss well enough! LSG finally sneak past 220, which is saying something about batting in 2026. Was right at the stumps but Himmat had all the time in the world to just bunt it over the batter and down the ground
Himmat almost ramps this into his stumps! Another slower 'un, outfoxed by the veteran Bumrah here. Dribbles back to the keeper
The yorker is a low full toss, now... But dips on Markram and it's really hard to get under htese. 120 clicks too, so it slows down and Markram can only loft it down the ground
Another pinpoint perfect yorker. Himmat swats it back with powerful wrists, so it deflects off Bumrah's hands and dribbles down to the right, so they sneak in a single
Classic Bumrah yorker. Right at the stumps, and Himmat can't do anything except dig it back to the bowler, on the bump

Best yorker of the over, from Chahar. Speared right into the blockhole on a seventh stump line. Markram looks to glide this late and run to the other end, but under-edges it back to the keeper instead
Himmat loves sweeping 'em pacers, doesn't he. Chahar sticks to his line full and well outside off. Himmat goes down on one knee and sweeps this to cow corner

Trademark Markram lofted drive, but straight to deep extra cover. Was in the slot once more, but he just couldn't rush down the track enough and time it over - or past - the fielder stationed at the ropes
Chahar lobs up a juicy, low full toss. Can only swat it across the line, down to long-on
Himmat toe-ends this toink down the ground! The delivery falls right in front of long-off. Was on a length and sat up to be hit, but can't there
Now, there is no doubt about this one: on a length and past the wide marker
Kept outside off, Himmat shuffles into the off side even more and cracks a superb sweep off the pacer. But deep square leg puts in a great dive to save two

Himmat confident it's a wide here. Was speared in full and past the wide marker. But Himmat had shuffled deep into the off side, so umpire reckons he could reach it with his levers if he tried. We'll trust the graphics guys to put up the digital line for us now, on the replay. And it's wide!
Pulls the length back even further, still at the stumps. Driven to covers
Crouches at this delivery, on a length outside off. Hit right to point

Himmat has picked the gap like a fortune teller here! Was floated up on the stumps, right in the slot. He goes down on one knee and swings through the line, hits it right between - and over - long on and cow corner
Eek, mistimes this hack through the line. Was looking to drive this from a length, outside off, but mistimed it to deep extra cover
Markram has boshed this one straight down the ground. Was a long-hop, rare one from Raghu, right at the stumps. Markram goes deep in his crease and sends this one away
On a length at the stumps, driven right back to the bowler
SKY fumbles this on the dive. Was a juicy full toss outside off, he drove this right to covers, where SKY lets this one burst through his hands
Himmat is brave to step down the pitch here! And great result too: middles this full ball, right outside off, and swings through the line to bazooka it over long-off
Markram has been hitting 'em too full all evening. Speared into the slot, on the stumps, but he hits it right back to the bowler, crouching in his follow-through
Back of a length and rising at the batter, who swipes across the line towards deep midwicket once more
On a length but drifting into the pads once more, flicked down to deep midwicket
Speared in too full, right at the stumps. Swept down to deep fine leg
Another flick down to cow corner. Raghu's been brilliant with his lines here, and LSG certainly in no mood to attack him, when he's floated it up at the stumps
Speared in full now, driven down to mid-off for an easy single
Keeps the length back of a length once more. Outside off and spinning away from the right-hander. Swiped across the line to cow corner
And now a well-timed cut straight to point! Floated up outside off, back of a length, and the batter crouched as he swiped this one away
Floated up and attacking the pads of the batter. Can only drive this back to the bowler
On a length outside off, driven down to extra cover

And just to ensure this over lives on in our memories, Himmat drives this right at the stumps. Was another dipping, slowish delivery. Markram went too straight in his placement but Bumrah was well away from the delivery, so the ball dribbles away and batters sneak in a single
Speared into the blockhole outside off, played late and straight to point

And now Markram almost loses his wicket too... Was banged in short and rushed onto Markram, who plays an unconvincing pull. He probably pulled out of his follow through here, because he realised the ball was cramping him up. Falls just short of midwicket
And now to add to the Mr Bean cricket, Markram splices his bat up in the air... Was a dipping yorker, 125.7 clicks, quite wide. Markram goes for a cross-batted hack but loses his grip on the willow
Slower 'un sliced out to covers. And he has overstepped once more. This really hasn't been Bumrah's night, has it? Malinga has a wry smile out in the dugout
And now this yorker is perfect... except for the part where he spears it outside the wide marker. Free hit stays

Classic Bumrah wicket, almost conjured out of nowhere! Was back of a length once more, 138.7kph. Moves away late. Stays low and takes the edge off an unconvincing Markram prod. Oh, wait, what! It's a no-ball! That's quite poor... Scratch all of that. Time to rebowl.
Oooh, Bumrah spears in a short ball now. But well outside off, so Markram can just bend back and watch this sail past him
Back of a length and angled back into, err, Markram! He's still out there. And he's bunted a drive down to long-on
Driven down to deep extra cover now. Raghu's been great with these attacking lines right at the stumps, and LSG have been careful against him
Another full-ish ball. Big stride down the pitch, bunts a defense down to covers and takes off

Great drift and into the pads, strong appeal from the infielders too! Was on a length once more, spins past the defense. Probably going down leg? No, they go for it! Let's see... It pitched outside leg. They lose the review. Not the greatest one...
Attacks the stumps on a full-ish line once more. But a comfortable flick down to deep square
Another great ball. Floated in slightly fuller, jumps back at the batter outside off. Defended down to covers

Raghu pulls out a piece of paper to show to the Wankhede crowd! Canny delivery, floated up on a length and spun into the batter. Skidded on as Raghuwanshi himself stepped down the ground. Gets a big edge that's lobbed right back to the bowler
Speared in quite full, he tucks this right down the ground. Ghazanfar spills it but was a bump ball
Oh now then, now then... Raghuwanshi runs back into his crease after an aborted run. Pulls the length back shorter. Flicked towards deep square
Raghuwanshi rolls his wrists as he drives this back to the bowler. On a length at the stumps. Almost young Kohli in those wrists, but without the placement on this one
Flicked down to square leg once more. Keeps it on the stumps, at a good length
On a length outside off, driven down to covers
Runs down the track, clipped into the leg side and they'll squeeze in two
Driven down to long-off. Length pulled back, still attacking the outside off
Oh hello, where have you been Raghuwanshi! Was floated up on a length, right at the stumps. He uses powerfulll wrists to just whip this acorss the line and over long-on

Rickelton astute behind the stumps! Jacks floats this one well outside off and on a length. Skids through because of the quicker pace, 92.1 clicks. Pant goes for a powerful flick, but his wrists only push a faint edge back to the keeper
On a length, at the stumps. Flicked down to deep midwicket
More conventional now: on a length, spinning away from him. Tucks this towards mid-wicket
Fantastic cricket, though no run. Pant goes down the track but the ball is fired way outside the wide marker. Pant smarts up and gets into a split, but back in his crease
Down on one knee and he's swivelled this over deep fine leg! Was on a length and drifting down leg, he tucks his scoop under the ball even as he is falling over
now Dhir runs and slides to his right to cut this off. Much fuller and wider of off from Raghu, and Markram drives through extra cover
has Dhir saved two? Looks like it. He was at deep cover point, and ran and dived to his left. Markram played the late cut off this length ball turning away to finish outside off
short in length, and on leg. Pulled to fine leg as he swivels in the crease
steps out, and Raghu spots that. So he bowls slow, and on a length on leg. Nudged towards deep midwicket for a hurried two
slogged over midwicket. Is Pant back in touch too?! This full ball dips on middle and off, and Pant swings it hard over the bigger side of the ground
shorter side of a length, and wide of off. Turns away slightly, and is cut to deep cover point
on the bounce to the man at square leg. Pant misses out. Short in length, and just outside off. Pant moves across and goes for the pull, but isn't entirely balanced while playing the shot
a confident drive to start. On a length, and wide-ISH of off, as Markram played it to deep cover point. And, it's a big front-foot no-ball

Bosch strikes again!! Both set batters are gone in this over. The ball flies flat to the man at deep midwicket. Another short delivery, and this one with a cross seam, around fifth stump. There's some extra bounce for Bosch, and Marsh looks to ride it. He thumps the ball really hard, but not powerfully enough and neither in the gap
short of a length, and wide of off. Slapped to deep extra cover by reaching out for the ball

has Pant edged behind? I heard an inside edge for sure. But this will go to the third umpire for judging the fairness of the catch. Short in length from Bosch, who banged it on middle. The ball went with the line, and just over middle. Pant looked to tap at it, and indeed, got an inside edge. But, but... the ball clearly looks to drop just before entering Rickelton's gloves. The third umpire, though, wants a side-on angle to confirm. My first impression is Pant is not out. Back to front-on. Again, it clearly looks like dropping before the gloves. The ball is grounded, the third umpire finally says. So Pant survives
a near replica of the Pooran wicket. But this is a wide. Short in length outside leg, and Pant looked to swipe but missed
ohh, he jumps down first ball but Bosch goes wide of off. The ball is angling across and arrives on a length around seventh stump. Pant thought of a flash but then let it go

tickled behind!! Rickelton knew he had his man the moment the ball left the bat. Rather, the glove. Bosch banged it short and just outside leg at 139kph. Pooran dominated short balls all day, but this one climbs much higher. He goes for the pull, but ends up gloving it behind for Rickelton, who's up in celebration even before completing the catch. The end of a tremendous innings
another attempted yorker. This lands on leg, and is jammed to mid-off
full and wide of off, and Marsh throws his bat at it. He drives it to deep point
this ball swings in, and arrives as nearly a yorker on leg. Driven with a heave to long-on
down the ground!! Six No. 8 for Pooran. Chahar bowls this fullish and on the stumps. Pooran crashes it back off a friendly length
slower ball from Chahar. He floats this much fuller on leg, and Pooran whips it to deep square leg for two
fifty off 16 balls!! Pooran is back at No. 3, and back in form as well. His celebration shows so much relief. Short delivery at him yet again, and he pulls over fine leg
flat, hard and six!! Short delivery from Bosch, and Marsh clatters it over deep midwicket
shorter side of a length on off, and dabbed to deep third
a yorker swinging into middle. Driven to long-off
on the bounce to deep midwicket. Another short ball, but this one skids through on middle. Pooran mistimes the pull - for a change
another big hit. Short delivery from Bosch on middle, and Pooran lets the ball shape away to pull from outside off. Six over deep square leg
he starts with a slower ball. On a length on middle and off, and the ball flies off the outside half of Marsh's bat to deep point as he pushes forward

the powerplay ends with a six. That's 90 in the powerplay for LSG's highest ever in that stage in their short history. Beautiful ball striking from Pooran. Another fullish delivery floated around leg, and Pooran thumps it over long-on
on a length, and just outside off. Punched to long-off
on a few bounces to long-on. This full ball angles across and arrives on middle and off. Pooran swings but doesn't find the boundary for a change
six more!! Where was this Pooran all this while?! AMG bowls on a length on middle, but the ball shapes into leg. Pooran yet again targets the region around long leg and fine leg
four this time. Pooran heaves across the line. This ball is short on off, and turns in a bit. Pooran waits and whacks it to deep midwicket
fires a low full toss on the stumps at 110kph. Marsh drills it back on the bounce. The ball deflects off AMG's right hand
a dot ball at last for Jacks. He bowls slow and on a fullish length just outside leg. Pooran pushes it towards cover
almost a carbon copy of the last ball. The ball sails over fine leg. Yet again Jacks darts this full and just outside leg, and Pooran clears his front leg to ram that ball for another six
slog swept over long leg. Pooran is back! Jacks goes on a fullish length on leg, and Pooran swings hard for another six
looks for the sweep, but is beaten by the lack of pace. On a length on middle, and he gets a bottom edge to short fine leg
aerial, and off the inside half of the bat - but he's safe. This full ball angles into leg, and Pooran looks to flick. But he mistimes it to deep square leg
bam!! Deep into the stands over long-on. Pooran waits for this full ball to dip on off, and clears his front leg to dispatch the ball
short delivery shaping away from leg to end on off. Pooran guides it to deep third
a hurried single there. Another slower ball, and this is very full on off. Flicked to midwicket
down the ground!! Marsh hangs deep in the crease, and launches this very full and straight ball over the umpire's head

four to long leg. Marsh is racing away here. Short delivery at good pace this time, but shaping into leg. Marsh beats the man at fine leg comfortably to his left. And, and... it's found to be a front-foot no-ball
shot!! That lands in the second tier over long-on. It's a cutter from Bumrah on the shorter side of a length on the stumps, and Marsh flays away at it
wide outside leg. And the batters pinch a run as Rickelton couldn't collect cleanly after diving to his right. Shorter side of a length outside leg, and Pooran looked to flick but missed
another short ball - this time at Marsh. The latter pulls this from middle for a single to fine leg. Raghu Sharma there nearly gave the impression that he was going to misfield
short in length, and angling across to arrive on off after seaming away from middle. Pooran taps it to deep third
driven to extra cover. He backed away early, and drove this full ball on the stumps right where the fielder was
short ball again, but Marsh finds square leg with his pull
floated very full on middle and off, as the ball angles across. Driven to long-on

got him!! A mistimed pull from Inglis. A quicker ball from AMG on middle, and short in length. The ball turns away slightly, and Inglis looks to repeat the pull which got him the boundary first ball. But all he manages to do is sky it for Suryakumar at mid-on. The MI captain moves back a few steps, and gobbles it

Chahar misses the ball, and it's four. He moves to his left from point, and lets the ball through. The ball went off the outside half of Inglis' bat as he went driving at this much fuller ball outside off
and the ball goes between those two men out on the leg side. Short ball on off, and turning into leg, as Inglis goes back to pull to deep midwicket

lovely drive. It's an attempted yorker gone wrong, and Bumrah pays the price. All Marsh does is extend his hands at this inswinging low full toss on middle and off, and he drives between the stumps and Inglis
slower from Bumrah. At just 119kph. He bowls it short, and gets it to shape back in towards off. Dabbed behind square on the off side
ohh, this stays low off a shortish length. Bumrah bowls it on the stumps, and Marsh pushes to midwicket by adjusting for the low bounce
nearly the same length, but the line this time is straighter. Inglis punches it to mid-on's right for a quick single

starts his season with a four. It's that late flick in which he opens his stance up and finds his back leg on off. Shorter side of a length from Bumrah, who got this ball to seam in and finish on leg. Four to deep square leg
short of a length at 138kph. The ball angles in to pitch just outside off, and slightly straightens. Marsh dabs it to deep third
fuller in length, and in and around off. Driven to long-off, whom I hadn't noticed was back on the boundary
a leave. Tight line from Chahar. He goes on a length, angling it in and pitching around fifth stump. Marsh lets it go and the ball straightens
full line again, but this one swings in to arrive on middle. Driven to mid-on
full this time, but four. Marsh perhaps knew what was coming, and hence walked down the pitch to turn this into a full ball on off. Four over the bowler's head
short, and six!! Chahar pulls his length back and goes short around sixth stump. Marsh pulls powerfully over midwicket by shifting his weight back
sharp outswing first ball. Chahar floats it full and it ends wide-ish of off. Marsh drives it to mid-off

Jacks knows this shot will go in the highlights package, and plays it with the requisite class! Was on a length outside off, sat up. He just speared his hands through the line. Lofted drive flies into the stands, was a six the moment it flew off his blade
Slower bouncer aimed right past Dhir's helmet. An easy swipe across the line down to deep square leg
On a length at the stumps, Jacks tucks a drive down to deep point once more
Banged in short, but too short. Jacks watches this sail past him knowing it'll be called a wide. So it is
Back of a length outside off, lofted down to deep point and Jacks will be happy with a couple for that
Full-ish and aimed at the pads. All Dhir has to do is flick this past fine leg and to the vacant boundary
Speared in full near the pads, tucked down to long-on

Whipped but he couldn't find the elevation on this. In the slot, on the pads, SKY knows he will eat those up for breakfast, except he's starved for runs right now. Right down the hands of deep square leg, standing a fair way inside the boundary. Can't finish it off tonight, SKY
Too wide, too short, and all class from SKY. He just rolled his wrists on a laaaate cut and he taps it down to deep backward point
Sticks into the pitch just a little. He goes for a swipe, from deep into this one, and goes to deep square on the bounce

It's landed right above the commentator's box, but this shot will leave you speechless! In the slot right outside off. Connects perfectly to this slower 'un and just lofts this down the ground, easy as you like
Speared in full, driven down to long-on without much fuss
Classy SKY drive to a full ball outside off, down to deep extra cover

Bangs in a bouncer, SKY goes for a vertical hoick behind him but misses. Umpire deems it too high... And now LSG contest this with a review. Above SKY's head, and well past his edge too. Takes us a while to ascertain it but third ump stays with the call
Low juicy full toss, flicked down to deep midwicket
Jams in a yorker, can only play it out to the bowler. Nothing to do about that
And now a feisty punch down to deep extra cover! Was back of a length outside off. He is deep in his crease once more, just shovels an elegant drive past diving covers
Woah, hammered down the ground like a veteran carpenter. In the slot at the stumps, he keeps a high elbow and an absolutely still base as he rockets this down the ground
In the slot outside off. Dhir can only shank this down to deep extra cover

Dropped at cover by Josh Inglis! Was a toughhh catch, tbh. Was on a length at the stumps. Dhir shuffled into the leg side and played an inside out shot right to Inglis, whose dive just couldn't hold onto the delivery
Steps down the track and drives it straight to the bowler. Was on a length outside off...

And now, Tilak splices this straight to Markram at deep extra cover. Was floated up outside off. Tilak decided it was time to go for it, but couldn't quite middle it. Straight to Markram and he doesn't drop does...
Whaddasave near deep extra cover! Back of a length outside off, SKY goes for another trademark lofted drive. Fielder puts in a great dive to save the boundary
Down on one knee and goes for a huge hoick across the line, but can't quite get under it. On a length outside off, dribbles down to cow corner
Hard length outside off. Tilak cramped for room and can only manage it down to mid-wicket
Sits up off a length. Swiped down to deep square leg, but straight to the fielder
Mohsin goes for a fiery bouncer, but it is too high. Umpire spreads his hands
Trademark SKY loft. Got more air than distance. Was on a length, straight bat and high elbow picks it up from outside off and takes one bounce down to the ropes
Back of a length outside off once more. Tilak rises at this to tuck it down to point
Top edge flies down to deep third. Was back of a length, outside off. He swiped at this and the fielder runs in to cut it off
On a length outside off, driven down to deep extra cover

No century for Rohit today. Was on a length, Rohit looked to force the pace against some accurate spin by getting down on one knee. He went for a big swipe over fine leg, but just wasn't enough room for him to elevate this over Shami, who pouches it up with ease
Late cut down to deep backward point. Was kept outside off and on a length
Another drive through to deep extra cover. Was innocuous and outside off, won't do for LSG right now
Flicked down to deep midwicket. Was pulled shorter and still at the stumps
Casual drive down to deep extra cover. He doesn't even need much more off these length deliveries outside off, atp
On a length outside off, driven down to deep point
Back of a length outside off, driven down to deep cover
Speared into the blockhole but Rohit still manages to drive this down to deep extra cover
Just hit-me bowling here. In the slot outside off, and this deep into his innings, he plays a majestic lofted drive over deep extra cover
Back of a length and swinging back into his pads. Dribbles away to covers and they sneak to the other end
Yorker right near the wide marker. Rohit reaches for it and somehow bunts it down to covers
Another nothingburger of a full toss, outside off. He just times a lofted drive to the deep extra cover boundary
Mistimes a pull but it lands well in front of deep square now. Stuck in the pitch just a little, short and coming right at Rohit's head. He swivels and swipes this out of his sight
You bowl it there and Rohit's going to swipe you into the stands, 100 times out of 100! Was a juicy low full toss right on the pads, and he just swiped a flick over the ropes at deep square
Back of a length and well outside off. Tilak jumps at this but can only send it down to point
Sits in the pitch a little, back of a length outside off. Rohit checks the drive to ensure it lands near an empty mid-on and he runs to the other end

Rohit has somehow tucked this one into deep square leg! Wrists rolled around like a kathi roll on the Calcutta streets. Was short and rising into his helmet, good bounce on this. Plays this late and to perfection
Back of a length and rearing up even as it drifts into the batter outside off... Shami-style bowling, really. Tucked down to covers
Slower 'un on the pads, easy flick down to deep midwicket

The first wicket falls, LSG might yet have a sniff in this contest! Sat up on a length outside off. Was there to be hit too, tbh... But he picked out cover to perfection. Rohit punches him on the shoulder to let him know he's done the job

Doesn't even middle this but somehow this has landed in the second tier... 124 clicks, ball sits up in the slot. Rickelton knows he just needs to run his hands across the line to send it over cow corner once more
Back of a length outside off. Rickelton dabs this late, to backward point, but knows there's no run here
And now an awe-inspiring swipe across the line! The ball was on a length, a little too full on this flattie of a track. Whipped the hands through this one and got it over cow corner
Rickleton chips this over mid-off! Almost perished as he flung his bat at this full ball outside off, but was in control of it all along
on a length on middle, and swung away to fine leg to keep going
another bouncer, and another slower ball. Rohit is beaten again. He's hit on his right shoulder as he looks to pull. The ball dribbles towards short third for a leg bye
great execution again. This yorker is fired on middle, and Rohit can only jam his bat down for a dot
slower ball at just 121kph. Rohit is foxed. A bouncer just outside off, and Rohit looks to pull by rolling his wrists, But he gets a bottom edge on to his stomach
phew!! Too quick from Prince. He bowls short and just outside off. Rohit looks to pull but misses
well bowled, but Rohit plays a lovely loft. It's a low full toss swinging into off, but Rohit is deep in the crease, and lofts it over extra cover by opening the face of the bat
incredible hit. That's 23 off the over. It's all MI. A much quicker ball at 107kph, but it's on that hittable length outside off. Rickelton rams the ball across the line for six over deeps square leg
outside edge, and four. He looks to slash it by reaching out for this length ball wide-ish of off, but the ball takes off to beat short third to his right
shouts of "catch", but the ball falls short of Pant. Rickelton looked to swing, but the ball popped up

just clears the man at long-off. Siddharth angles one across from around the wicket, and goes full and just outside off. Rickelton used the shorter boundary to great effect as he sliced it down the ground
short of a length, and wide of off. Cut away to deep cover point
bang!! Bowl full, and pay the price. Rohit reaches fifty off 27 balls. A repeat of the six he got off Siddharth last over. Full delivery on the stumps, and flung over long-on
this one keeps a little low off a short of a length on off. Rohit taps it towards extra cover, and they push for a single
fifty off 22 balls. His form continues. This is a length ball on middle and leg, and pushed down to long-on
flicked over deep square leg. It's a full toss just below the knee on middle, and Rickelton heaves it across the line by slightly bending to get six
wide of off. Avesh angles it across, and pitches very full and wide. Rickelton lets it go
shortish in length, and slightly wide of off. Slashed to deep-backward point
on a fullish length on off, and driven to mid-off. Rohit sends Rickelton back after an attempted single
shorter side of a length on middle and leg. Nudged to midwicket
good stop by Prince, who fumbles, but recovers well to throw it back in time. Rickelton swept this full ball around leg to fine leg, and thought of two, but was sent back
another full toss, and this time Rickelton doesn't miss out. Siddharth bowls this on knee height, and just outside leg. Rickelton swipes it over short fine leg
on a short of a length, and darted in just outside off at 103kph. Rohit cuts it off the bottom edge to short third
another six from Rohit. Listen to Wankhede! Full ball, and in line with the stumps, and Rohit clatters it over long-on
a high full toss on middle. Swung to long leg
full and flat on middle. Driven to long-off

has that been taken cleanly?! My first impression was that it fell just short of Prince at deep-backward square leg. Yup, the first replay seen by the third umpire confirms that. But the third umpire isn't satisfied, so he looks at more replays. He finally says the ball is grounded, so Rohit survives and Wankhede roars. It was yet another full toss from Avesh, as the ball angled in, and Rohit whipped it across the line
full toss... and six more. This one flies over fine leg. Avesh's attempted yorker ends up being a low full toss. Rohit, who's standing on leg, swipes at it for another six
not a great length, and it's six. Slower ball, and short in length. Rohit loves it there. He waits, and swivels to pull over midwicket. It's now 4, 4, 6
over cover point. This time he steps out, and opens the face of the bat after converting this into a full toss on off. Nice improvisation there. The ball trickles into the boundary
drilled wide of mid-off. Rohit looks away after playing that. On a full length, and around sixth stump, as Rohit drives forcefully for a four
nice swing and length. Rohit is deep in the crease, but it's still a well-executed very full ball on off. Rohit squeezes it to the leg side

lovely bowling. This one angles across, and lands bang as a yorker on middle. Rickelton squeezes it out towards cover
good work by Inglis. He's at extra cover, and intercepts the drive Rickelton plays off a length ball on off

beaten!! Rohit looks to loft this short-of-a-length ball angling across and pitching around fifth stump. But there's some extra bounce, and Rohit misses
another inside edge. This time the ball rolls towards cover. He goes driving at this length ball just outside off, but doesn't time it
goes over mid-on. This is a clean hit. On a length, and just outside off, and Rickelton swings across the line for another four
inside edge, and four. Mohsin can't believe it. He bowled it on a fullish length just outside off, and Rickelton went driving. But he ended up playing with a slightly closed face of the bat
good intervention by Shami at mid-on. He threw his hands to his right to potentially stop four. Rickelton had hoicked at this length ball outside off, but got it off the inside half of the bat
dot ball to finish. On the shorter side of a length on off, and pushed to mid-on
cramped for room by the sharp seam movement back in. He ends up leaping and slashing this short ball to point, and they pinch a quick single
superb hit. He just goes through the line to launch this over mid-off. On a length, and around sixth stump, and Rickelton lofts with the full face of the bat

Shami appeals for lbw, but it's turned down. I thought that was heading down the leg side. But Pant reviews. Shami angled this in, and went on a short of a length on middle and leg.
